hunks.baseline: Some people spend their whole lives afraid of water because they fell into a valley stream as children. Those who’ve lived through an earthquake carry trauma like a brand.
hunks.sol: Some people spend their whole lives afraid of water because they fell into a stream as children. Those who’ve lived through an earthquake carry the trauma like a brand.

hunks.baseline: But the greatest and deepest fear of all is fear of the unknown.
hunks.sol: But the greatest, deepest fear is fear of the unknown.

hunks.baseline: That’s what the unknown is.
hunks.sol: That is the unknown.

hunks.baseline: The universe and the deep sea, beyond the reach of even humanity, with its brilliant civilization built on science and magic.
hunks.sol: The universe. The deep sea. Places even humanity, with all its science and magic, has yet to fully reach.

hunks.baseline: And now, in this very moment, a single streak of fire tearing everything around it to shreds.
hunks.sol: And now, a single streak of fire tearing everything around it to shreds.

hunks.baseline: A storm of fire, so razor-sharp it made your skin crawl, turning everything it touched to ash.
hunks.sol: A storm of fire, so sharp it made your skin crawl, turning everything it touched to ash.

hunks.baseline: The Doppelganger stared at the scene in stunned silence.
hunks.sol: The Doppelganger stared, stunned.

hunks.baseline: Blue-white flames, pouring out suffocating heat, stained its pupils red.
hunks.sol: Blue-white flames poured out suffocating heat, tinting its pupils red.

hunks.baseline: Tearing. Ripping. Slicing.
hunks.sol: Tear. Cleave. Cut.

hunks.baseline: Limbs of massive, solid rock and weapons crashing down hard enough to split the earth—none of it mattered.
hunks.sol: Limbs made of massive, solid rock were no use. Neither were weapons brought down hard enough to split the earth.

hunks.baseline: They melted. They crumbled.
hunks.sol: They melted. They broke apart.

hunks.baseline: It took only an instant for all seventy-two Golems to become nothing but heaps of rubble. It happened before the Doppelganger could even order them to retreat.
hunks.sol: In an instant, all seventy-two Golems became heaps of rubble—before the Doppelganger could order them to retreat.

hunks.baseline: No—that wasn’t quite right. It hadn’t even had time to do that.
hunks.sol: No. It hadn’t even had time to give the order.

hunks.baseline: The flames tearing through everything hadn’t destroyed only the Golems.
hunks.sol: The flames hadn’t destroyed only the Golems.

hunks.baseline: A tremendous force raged through the air.
hunks.sol: An immense force shook the air.

hunks.baseline: The magic circles, scattering dazzling halos of light, exploded one after another.
hunks.sol: The magic circles, which had been scattering dazzling light, burst apart as if they’d exploded.

hunks.baseline: The Doppelganger watched in horror as the translucent barrier surrounding it melted like candle wax.
hunks.sol: The Doppelganger watched in horror as the translucent barrier around it melted like candle wax.

hunks.baseline: But before it could finish, something hot surged up from deep inside its body, spilling through its throat and into its mouth.
hunks.sol: Before it could finish, something hot surged up from deep inside its body and spilled through its throat into its mouth.

hunks.baseline: The Doppelganger spat out a clump of dark red blood. Its pupils trembled.
hunks.sol: The Doppelganger coughed up a clump of dark red blood. Its pupils trembled.

hunks.baseline: Knowledge surfaced from Siegfried Bassman’s memories and struck its empty mind.
hunks.sol: Knowledge from Siegfried Bassman’s memories struck its empty mind.

hunks.baseline: The forced severing of its connection to so many magic circles had sent the energy in its body into a frenzy.
hunks.sol: Its connection to countless magic circles had been forcibly severed, sending the energy throughout its body into turmoil.

hunks.baseline: If it hadn’t prepared the magic circles through various conduits and spells, and had instead cast the magic directly, it wouldn’t have been surprising if it had died several times over. The blow was that severe.
hunks.sol: If it had cast the magic directly instead of preparing the circles through various conduits and spells, the backlash would have been severe enough to kill it several times over.

hunks.baseline: *How? How is this possible?*
hunks.sol: *How? How?*

hunks.baseline: The Doppelganger gasped for breath and raised its head.
hunks.sol: The Doppelganger raised its head, gasping for breath.

hunks.baseline: There wasn’t a trace of composure left in its eyes, only shock.
The only thing reflected in them was one human who seemed as unknowable as the unknown itself.
hunks.sol: No trace of composure remained in its shocked eyes. Reflected in them was a human who seemed as unknowable as the unknown itself.

hunks.baseline: There he was.
He stood tall, gripping a silver spear that glowed white as the Golems’ remains rained down over his head.
hunks.sol: There he stood, gripping a silver spear that shone white as the Golems’ remains rained down over his head.

hunks.baseline: Then, through the halo of light left behind by the magic circles melted by the flames, the Doppelganger saw a predator staring straight at it.
hunks.sol: Through the lingering light of the magic circles melted by the flames, the Doppelganger saw him staring back.
A predator.

hunks.baseline: His voice sounded like it might break at any moment, yet boiled like lava as it pierced the Doppelganger’s ears.
hunks.sol: His voice sounded ready to give out, yet it seethed like lava as it reached the Doppelganger’s ears.

hunks.baseline: His unsteady footsteps approached, as if he might collapse at any moment.
hunks.sol: He staggered toward it as if he might collapse at any moment.

hunks.baseline: The whole place was filled with thunderous noise. The temple, stripped of its pillars, was slowly collapsing, and the rocks that had once been Golems were scattering in every direction…
hunks.sol: The temple was filled with deafening noise. Deprived of its pillars, it was slowly collapsing. Rocks that had once been Golems flew in every direction…

hunks.baseline: And yet the footsteps of that small human sounded like thunder. The sound of his voice made every hair on the Doppelganger’s body stand on end.
hunks.sol: Yet that small human’s footsteps sounded like thunder. His next words made every hair on the Doppelganger’s body stand on end.

hunks.baseline: The Doppelganger had to swallow a scream that was rising unbidden between its lips.
hunks.sol: The Doppelganger swallowed a scream before it could escape its lips.

hunks.baseline: Clear fear was carved into its eyes as it stared at Jin Taekyung.
hunks.sol: Fear showed plainly in its eyes as it stared at Jin Taekyung.

hunks.baseline: One who surpassed expectations and limits by an impossible distance, every single time.
hunks.sol: One who exceeded every expectation, every limit, by an impossible margin.

hunks.baseline: After dying countless times on the battlefield, the Doppelganger had long since abandoned its contempt for Jin Taekyung.
hunks.sol: After dying countless times on the battlefield, the Doppelganger had abandoned its contempt for Jin Taekyung. It had set everything else aside and judged the situation coldly. This time, it had been certain.

hunks.baseline: It had let go of everything and judged the situation coldly. This time, it had been certain.
The Doppelganger, which had left the battlefield before anyone else, hadn’t known Jin Taekyung had reached an even higher realm in that brief time.
hunks.sol: The Doppelganger had been the first to leave the battlefield. It hadn’t known that, in that brief time, Jin Taekyung had reached a higher realm.

hunks.baseline: Now that it had realized the truth, it was too late.
hunks.sol: Now that it understood, it was too late.

hunks.baseline: *If I waste even a little more time here… then I’m finished.*
hunks.sol: *If I waste even a little more time here… I’m finished.*

hunks.baseline: At the thought, a cold fear crawled up its spine.
The movement that followed was instinct, not reason.
hunks.sol: Cold fear crawled up its spine. What it did next came from instinct rather than reason.

hunks.baseline: The Doppelganger burned through the souls it had left without hesitation. It healed the body mangled by mana backlash, then gathered the energy that had once again filled it to the brim into both hands and unleashed it.
hunks.sol: The Doppelganger burned through its remaining souls without restraint. It healed the body ravaged by mana backlash, then gathered the energy that filled it once more into both hands and unleashed it.

hunks.baseline: The instant a blinding flash burst forth—
hunks.sol: A blinding flash erupted.

hunks.baseline: The Skeleton King, who had been charging at the Doppelganger a step ahead of him, hurriedly twisted around and put himself in the flash’s path.
hunks.sol: A step ahead of Jin Taekyung, the Skeleton King had been charging toward the Doppelganger. He twisted sharply and threw himself in front of the flash.

hunks.baseline: The Skeleton King in his usual state wouldn’t even have snorted at it.
hunks.sol: Ordinarily, the Skeleton King wouldn’t even have snorted at a threat to Jin Taekyung.

hunks.baseline: For all his bluster, he accepted that Jin Taekyung was stronger than him.
hunks.sol: For all his bluster, he acknowledged that Jin Taekyung was stronger than he was.

hunks.baseline: Protect him. Even if it meant putting himself in danger.
hunks.sol: He would protect him, even if it put him in danger.

hunks.baseline: For the Skeleton King, it had become the most natural thing in the world.
hunks.sol: At some point, that had become the most natural thing in the world to the Skeleton King.

hunks.baseline: At some point, he’d stopped thinking about the reason. Friends didn’t need a reason.
hunks.sol: He’d stopped asking himself. Friends didn’t need a reason.

hunks.baseline: The Skeleton King swung the Hero’s Sword down.
hunks.sol: The Skeleton King brought down the Hero’s Sword.

hunks.baseline: Golden magical power, bright as sunlight and strangely unlike magic, split the flash.
hunks.sol: Golden magical power, bright as sunlight and utterly unlike the magical power he knew, split the flash.

hunks.baseline: The moment he thought he’d cut it, the flash passed through the blade like mist and swelled like a balloon.
hunks.sol: Just as he thought he’d cut through it, the flash passed through the blade like mist and swelled like a balloon.

hunks.baseline: Before the question in his mind could finish, a light far brighter than the last filled the Skeleton King’s vision.
hunks.sol: Before he could finish the thought, a light far brighter than the first filled his vision.

hunks.baseline: In that blinding flash, which would have instantly robbed an ordinary human of their sight, the Skeleton King belatedly remembered the answer to his question.
hunks.sol: An ordinary human would have lost their sight instantly in that blinding flash. Inside it, the Skeleton King belatedly found the answer to his question.

hunks.baseline: This was Light magic, something even mid- and lower-level mages could cast with ease.
hunks.sol: This was Light magic, a spell even lower- and mid-level mages could cast with ease.

hunks.baseline: A simple convenience spell, rarely used in actual combat because it had little killing power and produced only a faint light.
hunks.sol: A simple convenience spell. Its light was faint and it had little killing power, so it was almost never used in combat.

hunks.baseline: At least, that was what the Skeleton King knew. Hunters accepted it as established fact, too.
hunks.sol: At least, that was what the Skeleton King knew. It was accepted as fact among Hunters, too.

hunks.baseline: If he’d known that Siegfried Bassman, a scholarly Grand Mage, had shut himself away in his hideout to study countless spells, and had increased the power and usefulness of Light magic by several levels, he could have prepared for it.
hunks.sol: If he’d known that Siegfried Bassman, a scholarly Grand Mage, had shut himself away in his hideout to study countless spells—and had improved Light magic’s power and usefulness by several levels—he could have dealt with it.

hunks.baseline: But the milk had already been spilled. The painful mistake was enough to make the Skeleton King’s heart sink.
hunks.sol: But it was too late. The mistake made the Skeleton King’s heart sink.

hunks.baseline: The Skeleton King was undead, after all, with a vitality that couldn’t be compared to that of a human made of flesh and blood.
hunks.sol: The Skeleton King was undead. His vitality far exceeded that of a human made of flesh and blood.

hunks.baseline: But even temporarily losing his sight while fighting a powerful enemy like the Doppelganger—and having to protect someone else at the same time—was a mistake he couldn’t take back.
hunks.sol: But even a moment without sight was a mistake he couldn’t take back when he was fighting an enemy as dangerous as the Doppelganger and trying to protect someone else.

hunks.baseline: In the white world where he couldn’t see a thing, the Skeleton King raised his sword. With his sight gone, his hearing took in everything around him.
hunks.sol: In the blank white world, the Skeleton King raised his sword. With his sight gone, his hearing took in everything around him.

hunks.baseline: The roar of rubble crashing down a moment later.
hunks.sol: The roar of rubble falling a moment later.

hunks.baseline: An unfamiliar cracking sound from somewhere above.
hunks.sol: An unfamiliar cracking sound from high above.

hunks.baseline: A low voice, too quiet for any other being to hear, reached his ear.
hunks.sol: A low voice no one else could hear reached his ear.

hunks.baseline: The Skeleton King heard Jin Taekyung’s Sound Transmission and understood.
hunks.sol: At Jin Taekyung’s Sound Transmission, the Skeleton King understood.

hunks.baseline: Why no magic had come flying at him, even though this was the perfect chance to knock him down.
hunks.sol: Why no spell had struck him, though he was an easy target.

hunks.baseline: And what the energy being carried quietly through the air was.
hunks.sol: And what the energy moving stealthily through the air was.

hunks.baseline: The Skeleton King’s guess was right.
hunks.sol: He was right.

hunks.baseline: The Doppelganger was now pouring all its strength into drawing a Teleport magic circle.
hunks.sol: The Doppelganger was pouring all its strength into drawing a Teleport magic circle.

hunks.baseline: It felt both relief and regret at having taken the soul of an exceptional Grand Mage.
hunks.sol: It felt both relief and regret that it had taken the soul of such an accomplished Grand Mage.

hunks.baseline: *You piece of shit…!*
hunks.sol: *Shit!*

hunks.baseline: The Doppelganger’s nature might be that of a monster familiar with magical power, but right now it was in the body of an ordinary human.
hunks.sol: The Doppelganger might be a monster naturally familiar with magical power, but right now it inhabited a human body.

hunks.baseline: If it tried to cast Teleport without a magic circle just to get as far as possible from the monster named Jin Taekyung, it would crumble into dust without even a chance to resurrect.
hunks.sol: If it cast Teleport without a magic circle to put as much distance as possible between itself and Jin Taekyung, its body would crumble to dust. It wouldn’t even have a chance to resurrect.

hunks.baseline: Mana flowed from the Doppelganger’s hand as it swept through the air, slowly wrapping around its body.
hunks.sol: Mana flowed from the hand it swept through the air, gradually wrapping around its body.

hunks.baseline: Completing the magic circle would take a little time, but it would cut the risk by more than half.
hunks.sol: The magic circle would take a little time to complete, but it would reduce the danger by more than half.

hunks.baseline: Instead of its body being disintegrated without a trace, it might at least save its upper half.
hunks.sol: Instead of disintegrating without a trace, it might manage to save its upper body.

hunks.baseline: That was more than enough for the Doppelganger to survive. And the deep-abyss monster, which had lived for countless ages, would never allow an intruder to interfere with this careful matter of its own survival.
hunks.sol: That was enough for the Doppelganger to survive. The ancient monster of the abyss had no intention of letting anyone interfere with a matter on which its continued existence depended.

hunks.baseline: A bone fragment shot in with a sharp whistle and was deflected by the defensive magic the Doppelganger hurriedly cast.
hunks.sol: A bone fragment whistled toward it, only to bounce off the defensive magic it hastily cast.

hunks.sol: With the magic circle nearly complete, the Doppelganger grimaced at the Skeleton King, who kept firing bone fragments without pause.

hunks.baseline: According to the Grand Mage’s memories, the spell was perfect. It had taken away the Skeleton King’s sight by striking the weakness precisely.
hunks.sol: According to the Grand Mage’s memories, the spell had been perfect. It had struck precisely at a weakness and robbed the Skeleton King of his sight.

hunks.baseline: That was exactly why the Doppelganger hadn’t bothered trying to disable the Skeleton King any further.

hunks.baseline: He was no pushover, and escaping as far away as possible from Jin Taekyung—who might do who knew what next—was more urgent.
hunks.sol: That was why the Doppelganger hadn’t tried to disable him any further. The Skeleton King was a formidable opponent, and getting far away from Jin Taekyung—who might do anything next—was more urgent.

hunks.baseline: But right now, the Skeleton King’s movements were far beyond anything the Doppelganger had expected.
hunks.sol: Yet the Skeleton King’s movements went far beyond anything it had expected.

hunks.baseline: The bone fragments, shot with incredible speed and force—and, above all, in a precise direction—finally shattered the defensive magic.
hunks.sol: Fired with great speed and force, and aimed with extraordinary precision, the bone fragments finally shattered its defensive magic.

hunks.baseline: The Doppelganger’s eyes widened in confusion as it escaped the danger with a Blink spell, taking advantage of that instant opening.
hunks.sol: The Doppelganger escaped through the opening with a Blink spell, confusion filling its eyes.

hunks.baseline: *How the hell…*
hunks.sol: *How…?*

hunks.baseline: It could tell from each of its opponent’s movements. Those attacks weren’t possible without certainty.
hunks.sol: It could tell from every move the Skeleton King made. Those attacks required certainty.

hunks.baseline: Even though the Skeleton King had taken the full force of the Light magic, he continued his attacks without the slightest hesitation.
hunks.sol: He had taken the full force of the Light magic, yet he kept attacking without a moment’s hesitation.

hunks.baseline: His hazy form shot across the space. At the same time, the golden magical power coating his sword traced a graceful arc.
hunks.sol: His blurred form shot forward. Golden magical power coated his sword as it traced a graceful arc.

hunks.baseline: As the sword’s wielder willed.
hunks.sol: As its wielder intended.

hunks.baseline: And as the voice in his ear directed.
hunks.sol: And as the voice at his ear directed.

hunks.baseline: The Skeleton King’s unhesitating charge wavered.
hunks.sol: The Skeleton King’s headlong charge shifted.

hunks.baseline: An ice spear grazed the golden hair whipping through the air and slammed into a pile of rubble.
hunks.sol: An ice spear grazed his streaming golden hair and struck a heap of rubble.

hunks.baseline: The air turned cold. The Skeleton King followed his senses and the Sound Transmissions reaching his ears.
hunks.sol: The air turned cold. The Skeleton King moved by his own senses and the Sound Transmissions reaching his ear.

hunks.sol: —Three steps right. Slash across.

hunks.baseline: Dozens of Magic Missiles shot through empty air.
hunks.sol: Dozens of Magic Missiles tore through empty air.

hunks.baseline: —Ten steps forward. Pierce it.
hunks.sol: —Ten steps forward. Run it through.

hunks.baseline: As expected of magic cast with a Grand Mage’s power, it was strong, and the explosions were spectacular.

hunks.sol: But none touched the Skeleton King. The Doppelganger caught its breath when it saw he had closed to within ten steps.

hunks.baseline: The Doppelganger felt as though it had been bewitched by a ghost.
hunks.sol: It felt as though a ghost had bewitched it.

hunks.baseline: *Was he always this strong? That mutant?*
hunks.sol: *Was that mutant always this strong?*

hunks.baseline: What on earth had he done?
hunks.sol: What had Jin Taekyung done?

hunks.baseline: How could he be barely standing, as if he were about to collapse at any moment, and still render the Doppelganger this helpless?
hunks.sol: He could barely stand, yet somehow he had made the Doppelganger this helpless.

hunks.baseline: The Doppelganger felt both confusion and fear as it gathered its mana.
hunks.sol: Confusion and fear gripped it as it gathered its mana.

hunks.sol: Before the Doppelganger’s form could blur, the Skeleton King changed direction and charged, lifting his sword.

hunks.baseline: In the slowed world, brilliant golden magical power surged like a wave.
hunks.sol: In a world gone slow, brilliant golden magical power rose like a wave.

hunks.sol: The voice came again, and the sword cut through space.
